title: Penkura
description:
Penkura combines top-down base building with first-person survival and exploration on an alien world. 

Build and expand your base, gather resources, automate work with programmable bots, encounter those who still inhabit this world, and uncover what happened to those who came before.

Take control of your base through the Command Center's tactical top-down view. Construct specialized facilities, manage power generation, hydrogel production, storage, and manufacturing systems. Expand your infrastructure while keeping the resources needed for production flowing.

Every journey beyond your base comes with risks. Gather supplies, manage your basic needs, and prepare for hostile creatures and unfamiliar environments.

PRAWIA allows you to program bot companions using commands, conditions, and repeating routines. Automate resource collection, item transportation, and farming tasks, including harvesting and seed extraction. Test and modify your programs to make your bots work the way you want.

Use your scanner to study unfamiliar objects, plants, and structures, adding discoveries to your Codex. Gather materials for crafting and production, explore new locations, and search for resources that will help you develop your base and equipment.

Explore abandoned facilities, investigate scattered records, and encounter the people who still live on this world. Conversations and discoveries reveal pieces of its history, allowing you to gradually understand the events that shaped the planet and its inhabitants.

KEY GAMEPLAY FEATURES

• Two Gameplay Perspectives: Build and manage your base from a tactical top-down view, then explore the world in first person.

• Base Infrastructure: Construct and operate facilities for energy production, hydrogel generation, storage, crafting, and resource processing.

• Programmable Bot Companions: Use PRAWIA commands, conditions, and loops to automate gathering, transportation, farming, and other tasks.

• Survival and Consequences: Manage oxygen, hydration, nutrition, and fatigue. 

• Crafting and Farming: Gather and process resources, manufacture equipment, grow plants, and extract seeds for further cultivation.

• Scanning and Discovery: Examine unfamiliar flora, fauna, and objects to expand your knowledge through the in-game Codex.

• Story and Exploration: Discover abandoned facilities, encounter inhabitants, and investigate the events that shaped the alien world.
description_short: Penkura is a sci-fi base-building survival game where you construct a colony from a top-down command system, explore an alien world in first person, and use programmable bots to gather resources, build, repair, and keep your base alive.
